candidates.explanation: The branch `else if (updateUserDto.photo === undefined) { photo = null; }` treats an omitted photo as a request to clear it. When the profile edit sends only firstName, photo is undefined, so photo is set to null. The mapper then turns null into a null photo on the entity, and the update clears the relation. That is why the avatar disappears. The create path uses `=== null`, which is the correct check.

fix.description: Change the condition to `else if (updateUserDto.photo === null)`, so an omitted photo stays undefined and is left untouched. Only an explicit null clears it.

When the profile edit sends only firstName, photo is undefined, so photo is set to null. The mapper then turns null into a null photo on the entity, and the update clears the relation.
